headword: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}
reading: けっこんそうだんじょ

definitions.explanation: A commercial service that introduces clients to potential marriage partners through profiles, interviews, and arranged meetings. A modern descendant of traditional matchmaking.

examples.japanese: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To register with a marriage agency.

examples.japanese: {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: We met through a marriage agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会員数|かいいんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: Major marriage agencies have many members and offer a wide range of choices.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (marriage) + ⟦{相談所|そうだんじょ}→相談所：29058_soudanjo⟧ (consultation office). A major industry in Japan, with national chains, regional offices, and online services all using the same label.

- {結婚相談所|けっこんそうだんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: agency member
